no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: ImmuCell is an animal-health biologics company (commercial product line First Defense for newborn dairy/beef calves; supplementary CMT for somatic cell counts in milk). It does not run human clinical trials. In December 2025 it paused investment in Re-Tain (intramammary antibiotic for dairy cows) to focus on First Defense scaling. Its products are licensed/regulated through USDA-CVB / FDA-CVM (animal-health), not through human-drug clinical phases.

commercial_product.name: First Defense product family (Tri-Shield, Dual-Force, First Defense Technology)
commercial_product.indication: Prevention of neonatal calf scours (E. coli, bovine coronavirus, bovine rotavirus) in newborn calves

excluded_legacy_terminated: Re-Tain (Nisin-based intramammary mastitis treatment for dairy cows) — investment paused December 2025; $2.7M impairment recognized
